Overview

Peoria is a city in IL with a population of 113,000. Illinois River city with Caterpillar headquarters, the Peoria Civic Center, and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
